segments.sn35.53:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.53:1.3: “kathaṃ nu kho, bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjatī”ti?
segments.sn35.53:2.1: “Cakkhuṃ kho, bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
segments.sn35.53:2.2: Rūpe aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
segments.sn35.53:2.5: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
segments.sn35.53:2.10: manaṃ aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
segments.sn35.53:2.14: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
segments.sn35.53:2.15: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjatī”ti.

lines: Aniccato jānato passatoti dukkhānattavasenāpi jānato passato pahīyatiyeva, idaṃ pana aniccavasena kathite bujjhanakapuggalassa ajjhāsayena vuttaṃ.
Sabbupādānapariññāyāti sabbesaṃ catunnampi upādānānaṃ tīhi pariññāhi parijānanatthāya.
Avindiyaṃ vindati, vindiyaṃ na vindatīti katvā vijjāya paṭipakkhova avijjā.
Vijjāya uppannāya anavasesato avijjā pahīyati, taṃ dassento “vijjāti arahattamaggavijjā”ti āha.
Na kevalaṃ aniccānupassanāvaseneva maggavuṭṭhānaṃ, atha kho itarānupassanāvasenapīti dassento “dukkhā … pe … pahīyatiyevā”ti āha.
